lines.trans: Nastya, how long have you had this guest?
Which guest exactly, chef?
That strange man in the dark jacket.
You could say, quite a long time.
What has he already managed to order?
Nothing at all so far, only water.
He is writing something the whole time.
Is he some famous writer?
But you were talking about that girl!
It turns out I have two critics now?
What should I do now, chef?
Immediately take him our signature menu.
I will do everything in the best way.

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

examples.text: Вспомнил? Я давно тебя не интересую.
examples.trans: Now you remember? You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: also 'girlfriend' (моя девушка)

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: adverb of degree

examples.trans: And in my opinion, it turned out quite delicious.

examples.text: У тебя здесь довольно уютно и чисто.
examples.trans: It is quite cozy and clean here with you.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'казать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to order', paired with 'заказывать'.

examples.text: Если опоздают, пицца бесплатно. Может, закажем?
examples.trans: If they're late, the pizza is free. Maybe we should order?

meanings.note: adverb of manner

examples.trans: The kitchen must be ideally clean!

meanings.note: Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'вестный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('famous, well-known').

examples.text: Он самый известный человек в городе.
examples.trans: He is the most famous man in town.

examples.text: Вы сами подумайте. Он самый известный человек в Синеозерске!
examples.trans: Think about it yourselves. He is the most famous man in Sineozersk!

examples.text: Он самый известный человек в Синеозерске!
examples.trans: He is the most famous man in Sineozersk!

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right
а именно = namely

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

examples.text: Вот именно. Но мне сдаваться нельзя.
examples.trans: Exactly. But I must not give up.

meanings.note: in questions
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!

meanings.note: Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'critic, reviewer' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

meanings.note: on a phone or in a restaurant; indeclinable

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'медленно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: You both leave here right now. And you never come back here again. Clear?

meanings.en: to serve, to attend to, to wait on

examples.text: Это слово «обслужить» часто звучит в разговоре.
